errors.evidence: The description omits the category "Средно еврозона" (Average eurozone) when listing the categories on the horizontal axis.
The description incorrectly classifies the category "Средно ЕС" (Average EU) as a country. It is an average for a group of countries.

errors.text_span: Държавите са подредени по произволен ред.
errors.evidence: The order is not random. The bars representing countries (from Slovenia to Bulgaria) are sorted in descending order of value.
The highest bar corresponds to "Средно еврозона" (Average eurozone), not "Словения" (Slovenia).
The value for the bar corresponding to "Словения" is approximately 22.5, not 38.
The value for the bar corresponding to "Естония" is approximately 15, not 23. The value 23 is closer to that of "Словения" (~22.5).

errors.text_span: докато тези за Словакия, Хърватия, Литва и Латвия имат стойности между 18 и 13.
errors.evidence: The actual values for these countries are approximately: Словакия (~18.5), Хърватия (~13.5), Литва (~13), and Латвия (~12). The stated range of 18 to 13 is inaccurate as it excludes Slovakia and Latvia.
